ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.
